review_applies_to_each_pdf.scientific_necessity: Locked source or supplementary evidence for the named benchmark case; removing bytes would break existing source-hash checks and offline recovery.
review_applies_to_each_pdf.public_source_reproducibility: Publisher URL/DOI metadata exists in the associated source lock; public retrieval and exact-byte availability were not verified because external calls were prohibited.
review_applies_to_each_pdf.normal_git_acceptability: Below the user-specified 100 MiB hard-limit threshold, subject to hosting policy and human review.
review_applies_to_each_pdf.git_lfs_material_benefit: Limited for a maximum 23.8 MiB PDF; changing historical objects would require an explicitly approved migration and does not resolve rights.
